data.narrative:
Aalo Atomics is a Series B-stage nuclear energy company founded by Matt Loszak that has raised $300M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 11 entities across nuclear energy—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach, using the $300M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $570M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient narrow peer density: while 5 same-sector peers exist, only 1 same-stage and 1 adjacent-stage comparable were identified, falling short of the 3-datapoint threshold needed for robust cross-sectional analysis.

The triangulation, based on the single applicable method, supports a valuation range of $484M (low) to $656M (high), with a median of $570M. Key uncertainties center on the thinness of stage-comparable peers in frontier nuclear, which limits cross-validation of the step-up multiplier. Expansion of the analysis would benefit from closer examination of the identified private peer set and public comps to establish whether current stage-progression assumptions remain appropriate for this sector's capital intensity and development timeline.
